annotations.title: Live flood warnings near a postcode

description: Reads the Environment Agency real time flood warning service (England, updated every 15 minutes) for flood alerts, flood warnings and severe flood warnings near the customer's postcode, and says what to tell the customer: flood water or a plumbing fault, whether to send an engineer, Floodline's number. Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland get the link to their own flood service. Use it before emergency_triage when water is coming in. Example: {"postcode":"YO1 7HH","radius_km":10}.
name: flood_warnings
title: Live flood warnings near a postcode
